method: Read-only comparison of git show HEAD:<file> with dirty working-tree source; declaration bodies, direct sorry positions, local textual dependency chains and whole-HEAD reference search. No build, no code/working-tree edits.
conclusion: All six declarations were already unproved at HEAD. Three were bare sorry placeholders. The other three contained substantive partial proofs with direct or indirect sorry dependencies; dirty-worktree changes removed those partial proof bodies when turning the results into named axioms. Therefore the axioms expose existing gaps, but saying all six changes only renamed bare placeholders would be inaccurate.
limits: This is a source audit, not a fresh Lean elaboration or exhaustive transitive #print axioms audit of HEAD.
No conclusion is made that every removed local lemma is independently complete, reusable without the surrounding proof, or already independently verified.
The displayed declaration types are textually unchanged modulo theorem/def-to-axiom syntax; full expanded types may also reflect other dirty-worktree structure changes, not exhaustively audited here.
Git metadata alone does not establish who made the dirty-worktree edits or when; no authorship attribution is inferred.
